scripts.storage:cat: echo "=== DEV (~/.config/craftty-dev) ===" && cat ~/.config/craftty-dev/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -n 80; echo ""; echo "=== PROD (~/.config/craftty) ===" && cat ~/.config/craftty/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -n 80
scripts.storage:clear: rm -rf ~/.config/craftty-dev ~/.local/share/craftty-dev && echo "✓ craftty-dev config + data cleared"
scripts.storage:clear:prod: rm -rf ~/.config/craftty ~/.local/share/craftty && echo "✓ craftty config + data cleared"
